title: Cloud-based Select Subject in Photoshop 2025: Subject Brightening, Sunset Glow, and Background Gradient
summary: PHLEARN’s Day 9 video demonstrates Adobe's cloud-based Select Subject tool in Photoshop 2025 and uses it to separate a subject from the background for targeted edits. The instructor first enables the cloud processing option, then applies Select Subject to create a precise selection that automatically loads into a curves adjustment layer mask, allowing brightness tweaks to the subject via a curves adjustment. A sunset glow is added with a Levels adjustment plus a gradient in the layer mask (radial gradient, with a foreground color chosen and the gradient reversed as needed). In a second example, the subject is again selected, brightness adjusted with brightness/contrast, and the background is enhanced by inverting the selection and painting a gradient glow behind the subject to achieve a more finished look. The video emphasizes the contextual taskbar, cloud-based processing, and the ability to toggle adjustment layers to compare results, and it points viewers to downloadable sample assets to follow along.

sections.title: Intro and cloud-based Select Subject Setup
sections.description: Introduces Day 9 and the cloud-based Select Subject tool, showing how to enable cloud processing in the contextual taskbar and image processing settings before applying a subject selection.

sections.title: Apply Subject Selection and Begin Brightness Adjustment
sections.description: Demonstrates applying Select Subject to create a precise subject selection, which automatically loads into the curves adjustment layer mask for brightness tuning.

sections.title: Sunset Glow with Levels and Gradient
sections.description: Creates a sunset glow by tweaking red and green channels in Levels, then uses a radial gradient in the layer mask to generate a sunflare behind the subject.

sections.title: Second Example: Brighten Subject with Brightness/Contrast
sections.description: Re-applies Select Subject for a second example and brightens the subject using Brightness/Contrast (noting that other adjustments can be used to achieve similar results).

sections.title: Invert Selection and Add Background Gradient Glow
sections.description: Inverts the subject selection to target the background and uses a gradient overlay to create a glowing background behind the subject.

sections.title: Wrap-up and Resources
sections.description: Concludes the tutorial with final remarks, mentions downloadable sample assets, and previews the next topic.
